title: Group Efficient Randomized-Adaptive Designs with Delayed and Missing Responses
summary: Response-adaptive randomization designs have attracted much attention in clinical trials. This paper proposes a new class of response-adaptive design which built on the efficient randomized-adaptive design (ERADE) proposed by Hu, Zhang, and He. The original ERADE uses a discrete allocation probability function and leverages the stopping time theory of stochastic processes to establish asymptotic results.
